purpose: Build deterministic adapter inputs and normalized result envelopes for isolated search-candidate prototypes. This is not vendor execution, a performance result, or a production search replacement.

prototype_boundary.vendor_execution: not installed, downloaded, started, or benchmarked by this task
prototype_boundary.network: no request is issued; Meilisearch request shapes are private-adapter envelopes only
prototype_boundary.result_meaning: Normalized results prove BPM input/output mapping only. They are not Pagefind or Meilisearch relevance results.

compact_documents.source: The four accepted synthetic evaluation-corpus domains, expanded once per locale. Only the canonical term and the reviewed alias are indexed; inflection, typo, compound, and accent variants remain query-only benchmark stimuli.

pagefind-1.5.2.index_input: minimal static HTML with data-pagefind-body and data-pagefind-filter attributes
pagefind-1.5.2.query_envelope: BPM-owned adapter query; Pagefind binary is not invoked

meilisearch-ce-1.45.1.index_input: Meilisearch document batch and filterable-attribute settings
meilisearch-ce-1.45.1.query_envelope: not-started BPM private-adapter POST envelope; browser-to-daemon transport is forbidden
